steps.title: Analyze Level Generation Solvability Issues
steps.description: Inspected current random grid placement generator which allowed head-on deadlocks and mandatory crash courses with zero solvable trajectories.

steps.title: Design Guaranteed Solvable Path Placer
steps.description: Designed a backward-induction level creation algorithm where arrows are generated in reverse order of their solving triggers, mathematically ensuring at least one viable exit path exists.

steps.title: Implement Trajectory Path Collision Checker
steps.description: Created a robust helper method to scan and verify whether an arrow's exit vector crosses paths with any previously locked-in reverse sequence coordinates.

steps.title: Configure Safe Grid Density Restrictions
steps.description: Enforced maximum arrow density thresholds (capped at 55% of grid slots) to prevent infinite loops during high-level generation while preserving peak cognitive challenge.

steps.title: Integrate Layout List Shuffler
steps.description: Added list scrambling logic post-generation so that the physical sequence of arrows within LevelData does not hint at or reveal the logical execution order to the player.

steps.title: Synchronize GameActivity Restart Routines
steps.description: Synchronized level loading in GameActivity to halt the running frame execution loop prior to recreating vectors, solving potential race conditions and UI glitches on retry.

steps.title: Validate State Stability and Arrow Retention
steps.description: Ensured the game canvas properly binds all fresh IDLE arrow components without coordinate discrepancies on sector restart actions.

steps.title: Confirm Audio and Particle Explosion Integrity
steps.description: Verified that custom synthesized PCM sound waves (taps, crashes, wins) and particle collision effects remain fully active and responsive across all 10 mission grids.

steps.title: Audit Package Namespace and Configuration Settings
steps.description: Verified consistency of the app manifest coordinates and build configuration to prevent execution errors.

steps.title: Building Arrow Flow: Crash Course
steps.description: Run high-level system builds to bundle standard debug configuration packages for direct user deployment.
